description: Purpose: fetch the stored result of the most recent revenue check already run for one site, without running a new check. When to use: the user asks what the last check of a site found, or wants to compare against earlier results; not for a site that has never been checked. Inputs: siteUrl (required, the site address as previously checked). Outputs: found (boolean), runId and the dollar-proof findings of that check, or found false with a null proof when no check exists. Limits: needs a Smoke Run API key because it reads account history; read-only; returns one check only; does not fetch the live site.

siteUrl.description: A public website address, for example https://example.com.

name: get_latest_findings

found.description: False when no check has been run for that site yet.

proof.description: The dollar proof of the latest check, or null when found is false.
